# GET /api/v1/admin/unadopted

Lists unadopted repositories (git repos on disk not tracked in DB)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-107`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |
| pattern | query | string | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []string

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `(array elements)` | string | Repository paths in owner/repo format |

- **403** — Non-admin user
- **500** — Filesystem walk error or DB error

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.ListUnadoptedRepositories | controller | Get list options from query params; Get query/pattern from form; Call repo_service.ListUnadoptedRepositories |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.ListUnadoptedRepositories | service | Parse query into user/repo glob patterns; Walk RepoRootPath filesystem directory; For each user directory matching glob, collect .git repo names; Batch check repos against DB via GetUserRepositories; Return repos that exist on disk but not in DB |
